shared_elements: frontal standing human figure with arms raised/bent outward
schematic geometric ornament accompanying the figure
justification: Both depict frontally posed anthropomorphic figures with arms bent and hands displayed, which is a near-universal convention rather than a distinctive shared motif; A additionally shows boats, a spiral, and a long line crossed by small stick figures, none of which appear in B. B is a single densely ornamented, elaborately costumed figure rendered with dense curvilinear infill and headdress detail, whereas A is a sparse multi-figure scene of matchstick silhouettes with no interior detail — the manner of depiction and scene structure are entirely different.
